description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Primordial], [Damage Cap +10000], [Ability Berserk], and [Starforge Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Primordial
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Earth abilities

description.name: Ability Berserk
description.text: Forces a random available action excluding Defend, affects targeting (single: random enemy/ally; group: all enemies/allies if the action's auto-target group is enemies/allies), Berserk, Confuse, Paralyze, Stop are prioritized

description.name: Starforge Mode
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 50% (cumulative), casts Grand Apocalypse after using five Earth abilities
